## Change / 变更

Describe the concrete correction and why it is supported. / 说明具体改动及依据。

## Scope / 范围

- Series and lesson IDs / 系列与课程 ID:
- Pages or languages / 页面或语言:
- Changes to media, subtitle bytes or download links? / 是否改媒体、字幕字节或下载链接：
- Source or terminology evidence / 出处或术语依据:

## Validation / 验证

List checks actually run and any unresolved items. / 列出实际执行的检查及未解决项。

- [ ] Stable IDs and original file mappings are preserved. / 稳定 ID 与原始映射保留。
- [ ] No unauthorized material, credentials or personal paths are included. / 不包含未授权素材、凭据或个人路径。
- [ ] Language additions are described as documentation, without claiming new subtitles. / 文档语言新增不冒充新增字幕。
